name: postgres_query_runner
description: Execute parameterized, read-only SQL queries against a PostgreSQL database using psycopg2, with query validation, session-level read-only enforcement, and structured tabular results.

query.description: SQL query to execute. Must start with SELECT, WITH, EXPLAIN, SHOW, or TABLE

params.description: Optional list of positional parameters for parameterized SQL execution

connection_string.description: Optional PostgreSQL DSN/connection string. Falls back to POSTGRES_DSN, DATABASE_URL, or POSTGRES_HOST/PORT/DB/USER/PASSWORD environment variables

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to return (default: 100)

returns.description: Query execution result containing columns, rows as key-value objects, row_count, execution_time_ms, and status
